title: How AI can use health data to improve patient care
script:
InSight Plus says our healthcare system ignores vital patient data.
Clinicians currently struggle with fragmented records across different digital systems.
AI can bridge these gaps by synthesizing scattered clinical information.
This technology enables smarter, faster decisions for complex patient cases.
The goal is moving past manual chart reviews to automated insights.
Better data utilization is necessary for safer, more efficient patient care.
Would you trust an algorithm to manage your entire medical history?
